_about: What guests say, per dinner cruise, summarised from the latest guest reviews of each listing (read 17 Nov 2026; Legenda and River Diva from the river page's 17 Nov read of the same listings), plus booking facts checked on each seller's own page that day. Counts are 'X of Y recent reviews'. Keyed by the card's review anchor. Never quote or name the review site in answers.

general.a: Every dinner cruise here sails in the evening. The city is lit from dusk, about 30 minutes after sunset, and the Parliament switches its floodlights off at 22:00. In summer the 19:00 or 19:30 departures start in daylight.

general.q: Do I need to book ahead?
general.a: Weekend evenings and December fill up, so book a few days ahead. Cruises booked through GetYourGuide (Hungária Koncert, the Dock 6 folk dinner, River Diva, goulash and lángos) have free cancellation up to 24 hours before and you pay nothing today. Legenda, booked direct, has free cancellation up to 72 hours before its dinner cruise and can move your ticket to another day at its pier if seats are free. Silverline, booked direct, has free cancellation and free date changes up to 24 hours before; within 24 hours there is no refund. Same-day booking works with Legenda and Silverline.

Only River Diva includes unlimited drinks (cocktails, spirits, Prosecco, wine, beer, soft drinks). All the others include one welcome drink; other drinks are paid on board, and you can't bring your own.

general.q: Which ones have a folk show?
general.a: Hungária Koncert (Rajkó orchestra and folk dancers), the Dock 6 dinner (Ökrös Band and a folklore performance) and Silverline's Folk & Operetta option (€91). The goulash cruise has Rajkó musicians, but some guests saw no dancers. Legenda has a pianist and singer; Silverline's Dinner & Lights has background music only.

All six have a vegetarian option. Vegan: River Diva marks vegan dishes on its buffet, and Silverline makes vegan dishes on request in advance. Legenda has no vegan menu and can't cater for food allergies.

River Diva is the one wheelchair-accessible boat here. Legenda, Silverline, the Dock 6 dinner and the goulash cruise are not suitable for wheelchair users. Hungária Koncert's dinner listing doesn't say; ask the operator.

Legenda: €84 for ages 3-12 (3 courses), not for under 3s. Hungária Koncert: 6 and under free. River Diva: under 4 free, full price from 4. Dock 6 dinner: under 3 free if not eating. Silverline serves alcohol only from 18.

Legenda has an open top deck you can use all evening, River Diva opens its rooftop after dinner (weather permitting), and guests on the Dock 6 dinner and Hungária Koncert say you can step out on deck for photos.
